name: dsh-plugin-open-in-browser
description: Open a sidebar file in the system default browser from the DSH document preview header, a tab's right-click menu, or the unpreviewable-file empty state.

scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/security.test.mjs tests/browser.test.mjs tests/host-route.test.mjs tests/client-bundle.test.mjs
